request.purpose: Production of official health statistics for the national health report.
request.question: What is the mean eGFR of patients with chronic kidney disease, by region?
definitions: Chronic kidney disease = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with N18.
Use the latest eGFR (LOINC 62238-1) per patient; patients without an eGFR are left out.
Report per region: patients with chronic kidney disease who have an eGFR and their mean eGFR, one decimal.
